about: The files outside src/adapters and src/ports that use browser storage (localStorage, sessionStorage, indexedDB) today, how many times, what they keep and where the internal app keeps it. The layers lint (rule 7, AX9) fails any other file that does, and any of these that does it more; take a file off when it moves behind a port (Prefs, src/ports/prefs.ts, as src/app/goalSeen.ts did). spec/rebuild/adapters.md shows this list as a table. Count: 79 uses in 25 files on 11 Nov 2026 (index.html’s first script added).

index.html.keeps: Nothing of its own: reads the appearance keys (src/app/appearance.ts) before the first paint, so there is no flash
index.html.server: This browser: a copy of the person’s appearance, for the first paint

src/app/appearance.ts.keeps: Appearance: theme, accent, sidebar, motion, sound and story mode
src/app/appearance.ts.server: Server: a person’s preference, on every device

src/app/demoBrowser.ts.keeps: Nothing of its own: clears the demo’s keys when the demo is reset

src/app/drafts.ts.server: Server: a draft follows the person from laptop to phone

src/app/research.ts.keeps: A research session in progress and its notes
src/app/research.ts.server: Not needed: Faro’s own research sessions

src/app/tours.ts.keeps: A guided tour in progress (this tab)

src/data/store.ts.keeps: The browser store itself (the demo’s records and saves) and the demo’s workspace
src/data/store.ts.server: Server: the goals store (the browser store is the demo’s adapter)

src/help/seen.ts.keeps: The last What’s new entry the person has seen

src/markup/backend.ts.keeps: The markups this person sent, and, with no database, markups and their pictures (IndexedDB)
src/markup/backend.ts.server: Server: the markup store and its files

src/markup/feedback.ts.keeps: Feedback triage kept in this browser when there is no database

src/screens/CheckInFlow.tsx.keeps: The check-in queue for the week (this tab) and the step a check-in reached
src/screens/CheckInFlow.tsx.server: Server for the step (it is part of a draft); the queue stays in this browser

src/screens/DataLayout.tsx.keeps: Each table’s columns and layout on Data

src/screens/GoalMap.tsx.keeps: Where goals were moved on the Map, and its only-in-trouble switch

src/screens/reviewOrder.ts.keeps: The order of a review’s goals (this tab)

src/screens/QuickCheckIn.tsx.keeps: Nothing of its own: clears a check-in’s step once it is saved

src/telemetry/staleCode.ts.keeps: That the page has already reloaded once for new code (this tab)

src/ui/BackLink.tsx.keeps: The trail of pages for Back (this tab)

src/ui/Demo.tsx.keeps: Who the demo is viewed as
src/ui/Demo.tsx.server: Not needed: sign-in says who it is (R1)

src/ui/ResearchBar.tsx.server: Not needed: Faro’s own research sessions

src/ui/Shell.tsx.keeps: Presenting mode on or off (this tab)

src/ui/Splash.tsx.keeps: That the opening splash has been shown (this tab)

src/ui/WorkspaceSwitch.tsx.keeps: Nothing of its own: looks for unsent drafts before switching
